summaryZh: Alexandrov 实验室结合实验与计算研究癌症发生的分子机制，重点分析不同癌种及癌前病变的突变特征和基因组变化，并开发 SigProfiler 等机器学习工具分析癌症测序数据。
researchQuestions: 哪些分子过程和基因组变化推动癌症起始与演化，并留下特定的突变特征？
癌前病变与进展期浸润癌的基因组事件有何异同？
topics: 癌症发生机制与突变特征
癌前病变的基因组改变
机器学习与癌症测序数据分析
methods: 实验与计算研究相结合
SigProfiler 癌症基因组数据分析

evidence.quote: The Alexandrov Lab University of California San Diego

The Alexandrov Lab Research Our research focuses on utilizing experimental and computational approaches to elucidate the mechanisms by which cancers develop and in leveraging this knowledge for the development of better cancer prevention strategies and the improved targeting of existing cancer treatments.
our work has predominately focused on creating the concept of mutational signatures
The Mutational Landscape of Human Precancer

The analysis will reveal the mutational burden, driver mutations, copy number changes, mutational signatures, and subclonal architecture of pre-malignant lesions and compare them to molecular events previously identified in advanced invasive cancers.
Our Lab has developed and maintains the SigProfiler suite of computational machine learning tools for analysis of next-generation generation cancer sequencing data.
SigProfiler tools allow researchers to analyze their genomics data and gain a predictive-understanding of the basic molecular processes that contribute to cancer initiation and cancer evolution.
